t: No part of the funds appropriated pursuant to this Act may be used at any institution of higher learning if the Secretary of Defense or his designee determines that at the time of the expenditure of funds to such institution recruiting personnel of any of the Armed Forces of the United States are being barred by the policy of such institution from the premises of the institution except that this section shall not apply if the Secretary of Defense or his designee determines that the expenditure is a continuation or a renewal of a previous grant to such institution which is likely to make a significant contribution to the defense effort. The Secretaries of the military departments shall furnish to the Secretary of Defense or his designee within 60 days after the date of enactment of this Act and each January 31st and June 30th thereafter the names of any institutions of higher learning which the Secretaries determine on such dates are barring such recruiting personnel from the campus of the institution.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that institutions of higher learning (outside parties) are involved in a federal determination, but they are only the subjects of a funding restriction and are not consulted or given a hearing or right to sue. The only procedural interaction is the military department Secretaries reporting to the Secretary of Defense, which is purely intra-federal. No comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or outside consultation is required.
fable.s: The Secretaries of the military departments shall furnish to the Secretary of Defense or his designee within 60 days after the date of enactment of this Act and each January 31st and June 30th thereafter the names of any institutions of higher learning

qwen_block.w: This section describes a reporting requirement where federal officials (Secretaries of military departments) provide information to another federal official (Secretary of Defense). It does not involve consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government (such as the institutions themselves, the public, or state governments) in the decision-making process. The determination of whether funds can be used is made solely by the Secretary of Defense based on these internal reports.
qwen_block.s: The Secretaries of the military departments shall furnish to the Secretary of Defense or his designee within 60 days after the date of enactment of this Act and each January 31st and June 30th thereafter the names of any institutions of higher learning which the Secretaries determine on such dates are barring such recruiting personnel from the campus of the institution.

opus.w: The section limits funding to institutions that bar military recruiters, and the Secretary of Defense makes those determinations alone. The only required communication is between the Secretaries of the military departments and the Secretary of Defense, which is coordination inside the federal government. The universities are affected by the decision but are not consulted and have no right to comment or object, so this is not participation.
opus.s: The Secretaries of the military departments shall furnish to the Secretary of Defense or his designee within 60 days after the date of enactment of this Act and each January 31st and June 30th thereafter the names of any institutions of higher learning

qwen_chat.w: This section describes a reporting requirement between federal officials (Secretaries of military departments to the Secretary of Defense). All actors involved are inside the federal government. The definition explicitly excludes intra-governmental coordination or reporting from the definition of participation. There is no consultation with or involvement of outside parties such as states, tribes, or the general public in the decision-making process.
qwen_chat.s: The Secretaries of the military departments shall furnish to the Secretary of Defense or his designee within 60 days after the date of enactment of this Act and each January 31st and June 30th thereafter the names of any institutions of higher learning which the Secretaries determine on such dates are barring such recruiting personnel from the campus of the institution.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the requirement for Secretaries of military departments to furnish names to the Secretary of Defense constitutes "coordination" or "consultation." However, this is intra-governmental communication between federal officials (all inside the federal government). The definition explicitly states that consultation or coordination between federal agencies or officials is not participation. There is no involvement of outside parties (states, tribes, public, etc.) in the decision-making process described here.
